QUESTION:
Which other drugs interact with Lisinopril?

RESPONSE:
Lisinopril, an ACE inhibitor, can have significant drug interactions. Common interacting drugs include potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics (which may increase the risk of hyperkalemia), nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) which may reduce antihypertensive effects and worsen renal function, other antihypertensive agents that can cause additive blood pressure lowering effects, and lithium (where lisinopril may increase lithium levels leading to toxicity). Additionally, use with diuretics may enhance hypotensive effects but also cause electrolyte disturbances. These interactions require careful monitoring.
